WITH s AS (SELECT f.sale_date d, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT r.return_date d, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id, net_sales_before_returns nsb, returns_net rtn, net_sales ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30')
SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id,p.store_id)>=900 THEN coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id,p.store_id)::VARCHAR ELSE 'stores' END grp,
 sum(s.gross_net) fact_sales, sum(s.staff) staff, sum(r.rn) fact_returns, sum(p.nsb) rpt_before, sum(p.rtn) rpt_returns, sum(p.ns) rpt_net, sum(s.n-s.dl) dup
FROM s FULL JOIN r ON s.d=r.d AND s.store_id=r.store_id FULL JOIN p ON p.d=coalesce(s.d,r.d) AND p.store_id=coalesce(s.store_id,r.store_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'),
r AS (SELECT * FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30')
SELECT 'sales rows' k, count(*)::DOUBLE v FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan store_key', count(*) FROM f WHERE store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup receipt+line', count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM f GROUP BY receipt_id,line_no HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_store dup key', count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_key HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg/zero net lines', count(*) FROM f WHERE net_amount<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'net vs gross/(1+vat) mismatch>0.02', count(*) FROM f WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_loaded distinct', count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM f

UNION ALL SELECT 'ret dup id', count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM r GROUP BY return_line_id HAVING count(*)>1)

UNION ALL SELECT 'ret refund>sale net', count(*) FROM r JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net > s.net_amount+0.01

UNION ALL SELECT 'ret to 999', count(*) FROM r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret refund_net total', sum(refund_net) FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales ts local-date mismatch', count(*) FROM f WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> sale_date

WITH sales AS (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999),
returns AS (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) v FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999),
p05 AS (SELECT (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<>999) - (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<>999) v)
SELECT round(sales.v - returns.v, 2) AS net_sales_sep_2026, sales.v AS sales_net, returns.v AS returns_net, round(p05.v,2) AS fiscal_p05 FROM sales, returns, p05
